title: config/checklist.json
description: The pattern of the item IDs of the checklists, and the markers of their states and the columns of their tables. The checklists are docs/plans/<plan>/checklist.md, which kit finds itself (K241); the hooks of a checkout are the arguments of its git-hooks recipe (K1099).

idPattern.description: The source of the regular expression that an item ID matches as a whole, such as K[0-9]+(?:[.-][0-9]+)*; an ID that ends in -<number> is a sub-item of the ID without it.

states.description: The markers of the six states of an item, each a bracketed marker such as [o] (K1110); without it the plan utilities read and write [ ], [~], [v], [o], [!] and [-].

columns.description: The header of every checklist table, which the strict reading requires when it is declared (K1110); the state is the last column.
